fields.placeholder: e.g. current single-rate plan, 30c/kWh plus daily supply charge

fields.placeholder: e.g. keep the fridge and lights on during outages

en.template: Compare 6.6kW solar, 10kW solar and an optional battery for {roof}, using {bill}, {tariff}, {quotes}, {ev} and {backup}. Show the battery's incremental return, waiting sensitivity and missing costs. Ask before contacting installers or sharing my details.

phases.title: Look up dated Brisbane prices, power plans and the official rebate and grid rules
phases.note: Installed prices and retail plans checked side by side
phases.judgment: It did not smooth over messy price data: the price index has no exact 6.6kW figure, one installer site’s tables did not reconcile, and the four installer pages were flagged as indicative ranges, not four comparable offers.

phases.title: Build the guide and an editable spreadsheet model, with sources and every calculation
phases.note: Solar only, solar plus battery, wait two years, and an EV from 2028
phases.judgment: It recommended solar first and holding off on the battery: the battery’s own payback is 11.9 years, against 6.3 for 6.6kW solar alone. It also labelled the power plans it found as existing-customer offers, not a shortlist this household could sign up to.

phases.title: Recheck the arithmetic, recalculate the spreadsheet and test desktop and phone layouts
